title: 自动记账服务端计划任务执行日志报错：sun.org.mozilla.javascript.internal.WrappedException: Wrapped java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused: connect (<Unknown source>#192) in <Unknown source> at line number 192
problem: 自动记账服务端计划任务执行日志报错：sun.org.mozilla.javascript.internal.WrappedException: Wrapped java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused: connect (<Unknown source>#192) in <Unknown source> at line number 192
cause: tomcat里面artry文件里localhost=127.0.0.1:8088需要改为时空的地址和端口号
solution: 目录：tomcat\webapps\ROOT\WEB-INF\classes，文件artery.properties里面localhost=127.0.0.1:8088改为时空的地址和端口号
